# x402 Querystring Toolkit

> Deterministic query-string parse, stringify, and normalize for agents. Stable key ordering, array support, percent-encoding. No accounts. Pay per call with x402 (USDC on Base).

## Paid Endpoint

- POST /api/qs
  - Input: `{ "action": "parse"|"stringify"|"normalize", "input": string|object, "options"?: object }`
  - Output: `{ "success": true, "result": ..., "meta": {...} }`
  - Price: ~0.005 USDC

## Free Discovery

- GET /catalog
- GET / (service card)

## Why agents use it

- Zero variance, pure transform
- Perfect for canonicalizing URLs before hashing/signing, building safe downstream requests, and cleaning tracking params
- Lightweight and high-frequency safe
